extracted.name: French Toast Bread Pudding
extracted.description: Great recipe for French Toast Bread Pudding.
ingredient_lines: Day old bread or rolls, cubed
Syrup of choice (we use a premade sugar free syrup)
instruction_lines: Find food storage container and fill with cubed bread. I used leftover rolls from my "Unexpected dinner rolls" recipe.
Mix together eggs, vanilla, milk, and spices. Beat well and pour over top of bread. Seal lid and store in fridge overnight.
Pour bread mixture into baking dish and bake uncovered for about 20 minutes.
Portion out and drizzle with syrup.
